invariants.claim: Canonical semantic identity is owned by Project0 and must converge on one cross-runtime addressing floor rather than being redefined downstream.
invariants.proof: Merged Project0 PR #28 declares itself the canonical-addressing winner, hardens RFC 8785-based identity across TypeScript and Python, and explicitly limits identity to stable bytes and addresses.
invariants.formalRule: For every admissible semantic value x, all conforming runtimes MUST produce the same canonical bytes and semantic address; unsupported runtime states MUST be rejected rather than normalized by a second local identity rule.
counterexamples: A downstream repository invents a second canonicalizer for values already covered by Project0.
Two supported runtimes accept the same semantic value but emit different canonical addresses.

invariants.claim: Addressed source artifacts are immutable: an artifact address denotes one exact byte sequence and cannot be overwritten with different bytes.
invariants.proof: Merged TranchNode PR #27 implements a create-if-absent filesystem artifact store with verified reads, idempotent duplicate writes, concurrent convergence, and fatal corruption detection.
invariants.formalRule: If address a denotes bytes b, every successful read of a MUST verify hash(b) = a, and any attempted publication of b2 at a is admissible only when b2 is byte-identical to b.
counterexamples: An existing artifact address resolves to different bytes after a later write.
A read returns bytes without recomputing and checking the requested digest.

invariants.claim: Creative proposal is not execution authority: proposal systems may generate candidate material, but executable meaning is established only by the repository that owns admission and resolution.
invariants.proof: Merged Toaster Lab PR #2 makes CreativeProposal explicitly non-canonical and delegates VisualScore validation, canonical addressing, and ResolvedTimeline resolution to Haunted Toaster.
invariants.formalRule: propose(x) MUST NOT imply admit(x); a proposal becomes executable only after the declared downstream authority validates and resolves it under that authority's own law.
counterexamples: A CreativeProposal is treated as executable without Haunted Toaster admission.
A proposal generator silently canonicalizes or resolves the candidate itself.

invariants.claim: Preview and production render must interpret the same accepted ResolvedTimeline through the same canonical execution semantics.
invariants.proof: Merged Haunted Toaster PR #18 makes preview sample the same timeline execution adapter used by production render, proves parity at canonical boundaries, and binds score/timeline sidecars plus receipt identity to that accepted state.
invariants.formalRule: For an accepted ResolvedTimeline T and canonical tick t, previewState(T,t) MUST equal the semantic renderer state compiled from the same execution adapter at t; preview MUST NOT maintain an independent meaning path.
counterexamples: Preview samples local UI state that production render does not consume.
The same ResolvedTimeline produces semantically different preview and render states at a canonical boundary.

invariants.claim: A refused action may leave attributable refusal residue, but it must not alter the protected semantic state it failed to enter.
invariants.proof: Merged Band Runtime PR #12 exposes the admission kernel through a read-only MCP tool and proves hostile protected-silence refusal with semanticEffect none, payload exclusion, deterministic output, and unchanged protected artifact hash.
invariants.formalRule: If admission(command,state) = refused, then protectedStateAfter MUST equal protectedStateBefore and any durable refusal receipt MUST declare semanticEffect = "none".
counterexamples: A refused write changes the protected artifact hash.
The refused payload enters the general semantic projection or durable semantic input.

invariants.claim: Exact replay must be derivable from recorded causal state and declared deterministic inputs, not from ambient machine or wall-clock state.
invariants.proof: Merged TranchNOSE PR #2 freezes the Experiment 001A deterministic receipt contract, excludes wall-clock, host/process identity, filesystem paths, and ambient RNG from causal run identity, and requires exact replay on the declared backend.
invariants.formalRule: replay(recordedInputs, recordedState, namedDeterministicStreams) MUST reproduce the recorded deterministic result exactly; any unrecorded ambient dependency that can change the result violates replayability.
counterexamples: Replay consults wall-clock time or ambient RNG that was not captured in the record.
The same recorded state and declared deterministic inputs produce a different receipt digest.
